description: Enable or disable every tool in one toolset (or `all` for every toolset) at once, so only the tools relevant to the current task are visible. Call `list_toolsets` first to see the available ids. Changing this fires the standard MCP tools-list-changed notification. No Alza-side effect — this only changes which tools this MCP server currently exposes to you.

enabled.description: true to enable, false to disable.

name: set_toolset
title: Enable or disable a toolset
